title: Goblin Camp
description: A band of goblins has set up camp near the village road. Deal with them before more travelers are harmed.

title: The Peddler's Cart
description: A traveling merchant offers wares at a crossroads. Perhaps something useful can be found.

title: Shadow Forest
description: Dark energy seeps from the forest. Something unnatural stirs within.

title: Mountain Pass
description: A narrow mountain pass guards the route to the next region. Bandits are rumored to lurk here.
